basic_info.description: 1257 Fulton is tucked away down a private driveway, located in a charming two-story cottage surrounded by lush, mature gardens, offering a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city. A wisteria-draped staircase leads to the entrance of this light-filled & inviting one-bedroom, one-bathroom home, which spans the entire top level. Inside, hardwood floors & generous closet space enhance the airy layout, while the updated eat-in kitchen features stone countertops and stainless-steel appliances, incl. a gas range, microwave, dishwasher, and refrigerator. French doors from both the kitchen & bedroom open onto a private deck, providing a lovely outdoor escape. Addt'l perks incl. extra storage & a dedicated washer/dryer in the shared lwr-lvl storage area. One-car tandem parking is included in a secured off-street driveway, shared with just one other unit. This home represents a 15.65% share in a four-unit TIC, offering a rare opportunity for those seeking a tranquil, garden-like setting within a vibrant urban neighborhood. Located in the heart of Alamo Square, around the corner is Divisadero St. and it's boutique shops, trendy cafe's, & top rated restaurants making every day feel like an urban retreat. Excellent public transportation.
